sentences.en: The people of London are very proud of this bridge.
sentences.zh: 伦敦人对这座桥非常自豪。

sentences.en: The bus broke down at one end of the bridge.
sentences.zh: 公交车在桥的一端抛锚了。

sentences.en: The village is connected with our town by a bridge.
sentences.zh: 这个村子靠一座桥与我们镇相连。
